description: Bloom Energy is a global leader in onsite power generation, delivering a foundational platform purpose-built for the digital era and the global energy transition. It manufactures a versatile fuel cell energy platform supporting the commercial availability of two main products, the Bloom Energy Server fuel cell system for generating electricity and the Bloom Electrolyzer for producing hydrogen, with its primary product being a proprietary high-temperature solid-oxide fuel cell technology that converts fuels including natural gas, biogas and hydrogen into electricity at high density without combustion or moving parts, achieving lower emissions and higher efficiency than legacy systems. It designs, manufactures, distributes and operates the Bloom Energy Server to provide resilient, distributed power for critical operations, serves Fortune 500 companies across the data center, semiconductor manufacturing, artificial intelligence infrastructure, utility and other industrial sectors, is headquartered in Silicon Valley, employs more than 2,000 people worldwide and manufactures its systems in the United States.
